title: Taiwanese United Fund 台灣人聯合基金會
content_html: The Taiwanese United Fund (TUF) is a Los Angeles-based nonprofit founded in 1986 to celebrate and preserve Taiwanese American cultural heritage. TUF facilitates cultural exchange through its Great Performance Series — showcasing exceptional Taiwanese performing artists — and Cultural Night Series featuring art, film, literature, cuisine, and indigenous customs. TUF also administers a grants program providing seed funding to programs and researchers that promote Taiwanese culture. Past highlights include commissioning composer Tyzen Hsiao to complete three major concertos in 1991, a sold-out Broadway co-production of “Finding Home” at UCLA Royce Hall in 2005, and a landmark 228 Memorial Concert in 1997.
